title: Naramata Full Day Lunch Wine Tour- Incl. Tasting Fees & Gratuity!
includes: Door to door pick up and drop off in Penticton Area
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb: Get ready to sip, savor, and swoon on the Naramata Bench Wine Trail, where breathtaking views and boutique wineries meet! Just a short hop from Penticton, this is your chance to explore over 40 fantastic wineries tucked along winding country roads, all bathed in glorious sunshine with the stunning backdrop of Okanagan Lake. Our Holy Sip Tour takes you on a leisurely journey through vineyards and orchards, letting you taste up to 24 award-winning wines at 5 amazing wineries from the list provided. Plus, you’ll have plenty of time to enjoy a scenic and scrumptious lunch at one of the vineyards (lunch cost not included and is payable directly to the winery restaurant). Come for the wine, stay for the views, and leave with a heart full of memories!
